load_dinov2_backbone: load a DINOv2 ViT backbone model via torch.hub for feature extraction
load_dinov2_backbone_with_reg: load a DINOv2 ViT backbone with registration tokens via torch.hub
load_dinov2_classifier: load a DINOv2 linear classifier head via torch.hub for image classification
load_dinov2_depther: load a DINOv2 depth estimation model via torch.hub for monocular depth prediction
load_cell_dino_model: load a Cell DINO or XRay DINO specialized backbone via torch.hub
